svg.text: Sizes on screen, schematic silhouettes and an outline against the grounds. Every colour and shape is a proposal for the designer to review; text and sources in reference-board-figures.md.
Size on screen at 1080p, to pixel scale (one pixel here is one screen pixel), with the placeholder camera values
Dashed: the footprint of a monster (its body radius). Monster heights are not in the data.
The root classes as black shapes, as the camera sees them: at screen size (top row) and enlarged (bottom row)
Warrior: heavy armour, sword and shield
One figure with a dark and with a light outline, on the lightest, a middle and the darkest main ground
The number is the colour difference between the outline and the ground (higher reads better).
